text: dsh-exec-extension 是面向 DSH 命令行的 headless bundle。它替换默认 headless-startup，为 headless-runner 提供单次任务入口。用户可临时覆盖模型、provider 和 reasoning effort，合并命令行任务、管道输入与文件内容，并设置工作目录、超时、沙箱和审批策略。它还支持 JSON 会话事件、保存最终回答、附加 JSON Schema 提示和打印模型选择，适合从 shell、脚本或 CI 调用 DSH。安装于 exec profile；--api-key 参数用于当前进程。

dsh-exec-extension adds CLI options to DSH headless runner. Override model and effort per run, combine task text with stdin or files, and set cwd, timeout, sandbox, and approvals. It streams JSON events or saves the final answer. Install in an exec profile; --api-key applies to this process.
我想每次运行 DSH 时临时指定模型和推理强度。
怎么把管道里的文本和我的任务一起交给 headless DSH？
我能不能在命令行里附上文件，让模型结合文件内容回答？
想让一次 DSH 执行输出 JSON 事件流，方便脚本读取。
Can I run one headless DSH task with a chosen working directory and timeout?
I need to save the final answer to a file from a command-line DSH run.
dsh-exec-extension 的功能「单次模型参数覆盖」：命令行可指定当前进程的 model、provider 和 reasoning effort；未提供的字段沿用原选择。这些参数在 exec profile 的本次运行中生效。
dsh-exec-extension 的功能「合并任务输入」：可把命令行任务、管道标准输入与 -f 或 @path 文件内容合并，并附加 JSON Schema 提示，作为一次 headless 任务提交。
dsh-exec-extension 的功能「脚本化输出」：用户可选择 JSON 会话事件格式，并通过 -o 将最终 assistant 文本写入指定文件；未选择 JSON 时最终文本保持普通输出。
dsh-exec-extension 使用前须知：命令行提供 --api-key，用于当前进程的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY；代码说明该值不写入磁盘。（见 js/command.js:153）

dsh-exec-extension README · dsh-exec-extension：[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-exec-extension) · [中文文档](https://github.com/LvDAO/dsh-exec-extension/blob/main/README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness **bundle** for one-shot exec, in the same shape as official surface plugins (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `parseCmdline` + commander). Stock `headless-startup` only declares `[task...]`; this bundle disables that row and inserts a replacement that still provides `headlessStartup.task` for unmodified `headless-runner`.

dsh-exec-extension README · dsh-exec-extension：The CLI follows **OpenCode `run`** and **Pi `-p`**: piped stdin is merged into the prompt, `@file` / `-f` attaches files, `--format json` streams session events, `--dir` sets cwd, `--yolo` skips permission prompts (it does **not** disable the sandbox). Model overlay is in-process (Rust WASM) and never writes `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`.

dsh-exec-extension README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile exec add @deepseek-ai/dsh-headless@$(npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh version)
dsh plugin --profile exec add dsh-exec-extension
dsh --profile exec --help
```

dsh-exec-extension README · Install：Follow the **same npm `latest` channel as the dsh CLI** (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` / `npm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh`). Do not use `@next` unless you installed `dsh@next`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-headless` has a stale `latest` tag, so the first line takes the CLI's `latest` version instead of headless's own. `dsh-exec-extension` uses its own `latest`. Freeze with `@<version>` only when you need a snapshot. npm install does not need a `prepare` allowlist.

dsh-exec-extension README · Install：Git fallback: `dsh plugin --profile exec add github:LvDAO/dsh-exec-extension`

Dedicated profile only. Stock `dsh --profile headless --model x "t"` must still fail.

dsh-exec-extension README · CLI：```text
dsh --profile exec [options] [--] [task|-]
cat README.md | dsh --profile exec "summarize this"
dsh --profile exec @notes.md --full-auto "use the notes"
```

dsh-exec-extension README · CLI：Unknown flags error. Overlay never calls `saveSelection()`.

`--output-schema` is a **prompt constraint**, not constrained decoding. `--approval allow` and `--yolo` install a process-local auto-grant because dsh `never` auto-**denies** and headless has no UI. `--yolo` does not set `danger-full-access`; use `--sandbox danger-full-access` for unrestricted tools.

dsh-exec-extension README · CLI：`headlessStartup` is `{ task, cwd, permissionMode, approvalPolicy, autoApprove, toolsMode?, format }`. sandbox-policy, approval, and tools inject that service (`!!js ctx.headlessStartup.*`). Stock `headless-runner` still only reads `task`.
dsh-exec-extension README · Non-goals：MCP, Host, HTTP, resume, `--image`, forking `headless-runner`. Put MCP on the profile patch + process env, not on this CLI.

dsh-exec-extension README · Develop：Node ≥ 22.19. WASM is committed; `prepare` skips rustc.
